articles.title: Flavio Bolsonaro insists he is 'leader of Brazil' despite losing election run-off
articles.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro has called himself the "leader of Brazil", despite losing the country's run-off vote to incumbent leader Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.

articles.title: Cruise ship left stranded in Cambodia after 'soaring fuel costs'
articles.summary: A luxury cruise ship on a three-year, round-the-world voyage has been forced to suspend the trip in Cambodia due to rising fuel costs, operators have said.

articles.title: Knife attacker shot dead by police outside Israeli embassy
articles.summary: A man carrying knives has been killed by police after attacking an officer outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade.

articles.title: Zookeeper dies after leopard attack
articles.summary: A woman has died after being attacked by a leopard at the safari park where she spent almost her entire 40-year career.

articles.title: At least 62 killed and thousands displaced in gunmen attack in Nigeria
articles.summary: At least 62 people have been killed after an attack in northeastern Nigeria, the country's emergency agency said.

articles.title: Mbappe apologises for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after being dropped by Chinese brands
articles.summary: French footballer Kylian Mbappe has apologised for an "ill-judged" remark about Mao Zedong after being dropped by Chinese brands.

articles.title: Ebola cases in DRC surpass 10,000 as nurse treating patients is killed by machete-wielding mob
articles.summary: The number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000, government data showed, as fears that the epidemic could spread to more African countries grow.
